purpose: Accepted identity cutouts for received dialogue handoff; no new identity design

prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Edit target: the attached accepted Jicun character design board. Produce ONE clean production dialogue character cutout on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, vertical 2:3 composition. Preserve the exact MAIN central three-quarter young Chinese man's face, dark navy swept tousled hair, blue-gray eyes, calm serious expression, navy long military-curator coat with narrow gold piping and its existing crest, ivory double-breasted waistcoat, dark shirt, leather shoulder strap with ID badge, wrist device, and gloves exactly as in the central accepted drawing. This is a faithful extraction and completion, not a redesign. Keep his existing relaxed pose and head angle. Frame from just above all the hair down to mid-thigh, both shoulders and arms fully visible and uncropped at the sides; no need for legs or feet. Maintain accepted KINETIC_CEL ink outlines and calm large color planes with two-step hard shadows, no new photoreal texture or grit. Remove ALL board border, labels, text, auxiliary faces, fabric detail swatches, palette boxes, vignette and floor/shadow. No text or watermark anywhere. Badge may retain nonlegible graphic bars only. Keep the character's actual silhouette; do not add a glow or backdrop. Provide enough transparent margin above hair and both sides for UI cropping.

Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Edit target: the attached accepted Baiyuan H02 character design board. Produce ONE clean production dialogue cutout of the MAIN central adult European woman on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, vertical 2:3 composition. Precisely preserve her accepted face and age, expressive knowing gentle smile, silver-white wavy shoulder-length hair, eyebrows, proportions and skin tone, cream white belted dress with the same neckline, ivory coat with the black lining and buttons, black gloves, tiny necklace, and her black storyboard binder and pen in the same relaxed pose. This is faithful extraction of the accepted character, not a new face or outfit. Keep the same head angle and three-quarter pose. Frame from just above all hair to mid-thigh. Keep hair, shoulder width, elbows, hands and binder fully visible and clear from the canvas edges. Preserve the accepted KINETIC_CEL pressure-varied ink and broad cream/black color planes with two-step cel shadows. Remove every board label, border, logo, text, isolated portrait circle and color/shape diagram. On the binder remove written words but retain its plain black cover and small simple decorative emblem. NO typography, letters, watermarks, scene background, drop shadow, halo or light bloom. Transparent margins above and on both sides are needed for later consistent dialogue head and bust cropping.
